title: Bad Battery life on Watch since 'Nightly build 1st Oct 2020'
symptom: After updating to the Nightly build of 1st Oct 2020, the watch battery life degraded significantly (e.g., 14% after 12h instead of 60%). Reverting to the 4th Sep 2020 build restored battery life.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. It speculates about excessive alarms and wakelocks related to Bluetooth, possibly linked to the JodaTime change in the 2020.10.01 build, but no confirmation is provided.
fix: The thread does not state a definitive fix. Users report that reverting to an older build (e.g., 2020.09.04) improves battery life, and one user mentions that removing the complication and force stopping xDrip on the watch reduces consumption, but these are workarounds, not an official fix.
evidence_quote: After Oct. update the watch had 14% Battery after 12h, before around 60%. Now I am back on '_Nightly build 4th Sep 2020_' and after 12h it shows me 60% again.
